synopsis: The library table holds three sources of different weight: the former learner's letter with one question left declined, the physical page's layered ink, and the class's own notes. Sophie wants to pull them into one clean account tonight, but Henry names that the sources will not merge and refuses to invent an author field. Together they turn the number notebook into an evidence map where colour marks certainty and source; the learner keeps the declined claim open, then assembles source, confidence, and Japanese evidence phrases for the map's three rows.

forbiddenClaims: surname, guessed kana name, nationality, job, or private history
confident inference framed as unchallengeable fact
any anxiety, clinical, or fragility framing of her wish to be fast and liked
surname, guessed kana name, or private history
a technical workaround presented as resolving the atlas's provenance

scenes.goal: Lay out three sources of unequal reliability and reach the point where merging them into one account would mean inventing what the record cannot support.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Faced with sources that disagree, will the class write one clean story, or a map that keeps each claim at its true confidence?
scenes.learnerNeed: A synthesis task where sorting each claim to its source and marking how sure it is matters more than producing a single finished account.

nodes.description: The library closing bell is forty minutes away. Across the long table, Sophie's coloured tabs already make a confident-looking grid: the former learner's letter, paper and ink samples from the old page, and the class's notes. Two claims in the front row carry the same dark green, though one comes from direct testimony and the other from a mark on paper. Henry has stopped with one finger between them.

nodes.intent: Spread the three sources as a finishable job and lean toward pulling them into one clean account tonight, her finish-first reflex reaching for a single story.
nodes.attentionTarget: the three sources laid out and the empty notebook spread waiting for one account

n3.japanese: 閉館まで四十分。手紙、紙、私たちのメモ。今夜、この一枚までは仕上げたい。…濃い緑が『確か』。今のところ、この二枚は同じ色でいいよね。
n3.reading: へいかんまでよんじゅっぷん。てがみ、かみ、わたしたちのメモ。こんや、このいちまいまではしあげたい。…こいみどりが『たしか』。いまのところ、このにまいはおなじいろでいいよね。
n3.english: Forty minutes to closing. Letter, paper, our notes. I want this sheet finished tonight. …Dark green means 'certain.' These two can share it for now, right?

n2.japanese: 閉館まで四十分。あの人の返事、紙そのもの、私たちのメモ。今夜、この一枚だけは仕上げたいんだ。…濃い緑を『確実』にしたから、この二枚は同じ色で置けると思って。
n2.reading: へいかんまでよんじゅっぷん。あのひとのへんじ、かみそのもの、わたしたちのメモ。こんや、このいちまいだけはしあげたいんだ。…こいみどりを『かくじつ』にしたから、このにまいはおなじいろでおけるとおもって。

n1.japanese: 閉館まで四十分。あの人からの返書、紙そのもの、それに私たちのメモ。せめて今夜、この一枚は仕上げたいと思って。…濃い緑を『確実』にしたから、この二枚は同じ色で置けるかな、と。

n1.english: Forty minutes to closing. Her reply, the paper itself, our notes. At least this sheet, tonight. …Dark green means 'established,' so I was going to give both claims the same colour.

nodes.intent: Point to two dark-green cards with different sources and ask Sophie to label source separately from certainty.
nodes.attentionTarget: the matching colours on the letter card and the paper-inference card

n2.japanese: 待って。同じ緑だと、同じ確かさに見える。こっちは手紙にあること。こっちは紙の跡からの推測。出どころと確かさ、分けない？
n2.reading: まって。おなじみどりだと、おなじたしかさにみえる。こっちはてがみにあること。こっちはかみのあとからのすいそく。でどころとたしかさ、わけない？
n2.english: Wait. The same green makes them look equally certain. This one is in the letter; this one is an inference from the paper. Can we separate source from certainty?

n1.japanese: 待って。同じ濃い緑だと、この二枚が同じくらい確かに見える。こっちは本人の手紙。こっちは紙の跡からの推測。……きれいに並ぶほど、混ぜたらまずいな。出どころと確かさ、分けませんか。
n1.reading: まって。おなじこいみどりだと、このにまいがおなじくらいたしかにみえる。こっちはほんにんのてがみ。こっちはかみのあとからのすいそく。……きれいにならぶほど、まぜたらまずいな。でどころとたしかさ、わけませんか。
n1.english: Wait. The same dark green makes these two look equally certain. This is her letter; this is a guess from marks on the paper. …The neater it looks, the worse it is if we mix them. Can we separate source from certainty?

nodes.intent: Take the turn away from one account and toward a map where every claim carries its source and its confidence, giving her colour-coding the new job and naming the diagnostic level 'this only goes as far as apparently.'
nodes.attentionTarget: her coloured pens, now standing in for degrees of certainty rather than topics

n3.japanese: ……そっか。じゃあ、一つにまとめず、地図にしよう。手紙にあることは濃く、紙を見て分かることは薄く。ここは……色なし。まだ分からないから。
n3.reading: ……そっか。じゃあ、ひとつにまとめず、ちずにしよう。てがみにあることはこく、かみをみてわかることはうすく。ここは……いろなし。まだわからないから。
n3.english: …Right. Then let's not make it one account. Let's make a map: dark for what the letter says, pale for what the paper shows. And here… no colour. We don't know yet.

n2.japanese: ……なるほど。無理に一つにせず、地図にしよう。手紙にあることは濃く、紙から読めることは薄く。ここは……色なし。まだ分からないから。
n2.reading: ……なるほど。むりにひとつにせず、ちずにしよう。てがみにあることはこく、かみからよめることはうすく。ここは……いろなし。まだわからないから。
n2.english: …I see. Let's not force it into one account. Let's make a map: dark for what the letter says, pale for what the paper supports. And here… no colour. We don't know yet.

n1.japanese: ……なるほど。じゃあ、無理に一つにしないで、地図にしようか。手紙で本人が言ってるところは濃く、紙を見て『たぶん』までなら薄く。ここは……色なし。分からないんだもの。
n1.reading: ……なるほど。じゃあ、むりにひとつにしないで、ちずにしようか。てがみでほんにんがいってるところはこく、かみをみて『たぶん』までならうすく。ここは……いろなし。わからないんだもの。
n1.english: …I see. Then let's not force them into one account. Let's make a map: dark where she says it in the letter, pale where the paper gets us only to 'probably.' And here… no colour. We don't know.

nodes.resume: The three sources are laid out and the plan is a map, not one account. The learner steps in to sort each claim to its source, mark how sure it is with the right hedge, and leave what the record cannot support as a labelled blank.

nodes.resumeContext: Three sources of unequal weight are in front of the learner: the letter (what she stated, with one point declined), the physical page (layered ink from several classes, no author line), and the class notes. The learner places each claim in its cell, tags it with source attribution and the confidence its evidence warrants — 〜によると for the letter, 〜らしい / 〜ようだ for what the paper only suggests, a flat statement only where the evidence is firm — and leaves the earliest-origin claim, which no source supports, as a blank labelled 'we don't know this yet' rather than filling it.

nodes.description: Only the one cell whose confidence tag outran its source is lifted back out. Its coloured tab is set to the side while the source line under it is read again, slower. The cells already placed stay exactly where they are.

nodes.resume: Each claim now sits under its source with a colour that matches how sure it is, and the unsupported cell is a labelled blank. Henry looks over the finished grid before touching anything.

nodes.intent: Check that each colour matches its source status, then catch his old impulse to add a pale tab merely to make the grid look complete.
nodes.attentionTarget: the uncoloured cell and the legend entry that explains it

n2.japanese: うん。色と出どころが合ってる。空白も、凡例を見れば『資料なし』だ。前なら薄い色を足してたかも。でも、それじゃ推測が一つ増える。このままで。
n2.reading: うん。いろとでどころがあってる。くうはくも、はんれいをみれば『しりょうなし』だ。まえならうすいいろをたしてたかも。でも、それじゃすいそくがひとつふえる。このままで。
n2.english: Yeah. The colours match the sources, and the legend makes the blank 'no source.' I might have added a pale tab before. But that would add one more guess. Leave it.

n1.japanese: うん。色を見れば、どこから出た話か分かる。空白も、凡例を見れば『資料なし』だ。前なら見栄えで薄い色を足したかもしれないけど……それ、推測を一個増やすだけだな。このままで。
n1.reading: うん。いろをみれば、どこからでたはなしかわかる。くうはくも、はんれいをみれば『しりょうなし』だ。まえならみばえでうすいいろをたしたかもしれないけど……それ、すいそくをいっこふやすだけだな。このままで。
n1.english: Yeah. The colour shows where each claim came from, and the legend makes the blank 'no source.' Before, I might have added a pale tab for appearances, but… that just adds another guess. Leave it.

nodes.description: A large sheet now covers the table, ruled into cells. Each filled cell carries a coloured tab and a short source line under it. One cell near the middle is left uncoloured, a single phrase written across it and nothing else.

scenes.goal: Finish the legend before closing time and decide how it distinguishes a claim unsupported by any source from a question the former learner expressly declined.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Will the map keep 'no source found' and 'the source declined' visibly distinct when the venue asks for one clean answer?
scenes.learnerNeed: A stance on holding a claim the record cannot support and a person chose not to answer, keeping both facts visible.

nodes.description: The map is nearly full. In the middle, one uncoloured cell carries a source line instead of a claim: absent from every record checked. Sophie's old two-column notebook is wedged under the ruler, keeping the new grid from curling.

nodes.intent: Name the labelled blank as the strongest cell on the map, mark her own change from wanting every cell filled, and tie the whole map back to the number notebook as its grown-up form.
nodes.attentionTarget: the empty cell that reads 'we don't know this yet,' and the notebook it grew out of

n3.japanese: ここ、まだ色がない。前なら何か書いて埋めてた。でも、どの資料にもないなら、『まだ分からない』でいい。数字のノートと同じ。数えた場所も一緒に残したよね。
n3.reading: ここ、まだいろがない。まえならなにかかいてうめてた。でも、どのしりょうにもないなら、『まだわからない』でいい。すうじのノートとおなじ。かぞえたばしょもいっしょにのこしたよね。
n3.english: This one still has no colour. Before, I would have filled it with something. But if none of the records say it, 'we don't know yet' is enough. Same as the number notebook. We kept where each count came from too.

n2.japanese: この空白、前なら埋めてた。全部そろってるほうが正確に見えたから。でも、どの資料にもないなら、『まだ分からない』でいい。数字のノートと同じ。数と場所を一緒に残したでしょう。
n2.reading: このくうはく、まえならうめてた。ぜんぶそろってるほうがせいかくにみえたから。でも、どのしりょうにもないなら、『まだわからない』でいい。すうじのノートとおなじ。かずとばしょをいっしょにのこしたでしょう。
n2.english: I would have filled this blank before. A complete grid looked more accurate. But if none of the records say it, 'we don't know yet' is enough. Same as the number notebook. We kept the count and its source together.

n1.japanese: この空白、前なら埋めてたな。全部そろってるほうが正確に見えたから。……でも、どこにも書いてないなら、ここは『まだ分からない』でいい。数字のノートのときと同じ。数と一緒に、どこで数えたかも残したでしょう。
n1.reading: このくうはく、まえならうめてたな。ぜんぶそろってるほうがせいかくにみえたから。……でも、どこにもかいてないなら、ここは『まだわからない』でいい。すうじのノートのときとおなじ。かずといっしょに、どこでかぞえたかものこしたでしょう。
n1.english: I would have filled this blank before. A complete grid looked more accurate. …But if none of the records say it, 'we don't know yet' is enough. Same as the number notebook. We kept where each count came from, remember?

nodes.question: The one question she declined to answer — how should the map hold it?

options.action: Record it as her choice not to answer, and leave the cell open rather than infer past it.

japaneseByBand.n3: 答えを断られたところは、『本人が話さないと決めた』って、そのまま書いておこう。こっちで推測して埋めない。それも一つの記録だから。
japaneseByBand.n2: あの人が答えを控えた点は、『本人が話さないことを選んだ』と、そのまま残しておこう。こっちで推測して埋めたりしないで。断ったこと自体が、はっきりした記録だから。
japaneseByBand.n1: あの人が答えを控えたところは、無理に推さずに、『本人が話さないと決めた』と、そのまま書き残しておこう。空欄をこっちの想像で埋めにいかない。……答えないという選択そのものが、一つのはっきりした記録なんだと思う。

japaneseByBand.n3: 主張のマスは空けたままにして、横の出典メモに『本人は回答を控えた』と書こうか。資料がない空白とは違うって、見れば分かるように。
japaneseByBand.n2: 主張のマスは空けたまま、出典の欄に『本人は回答を控えた』と残すのはどう? 記録が見つからない空白とは、そこで分けられる。
japaneseByBand.n1: 主張のマスは空けたまま、脇の出典欄に『本人は回答を控えた』と残そうか。資料が見つからない空白とは、そこで区別できる。

nodes.resume: The learner has chosen how the map holds the declined claim. Henry answers by setting up the map's data so the gap survives on screen and no cleaner draft can quietly overwrite it.

nodes.intent: Commit to building the map's data so blanks stay blank on screen and versions are dated, changed behavior after the wrong-draft incident: the tool itself now shows where it is uncertain rather than smoothing it over.
nodes.attentionTarget: the same empty cell rendered empty on the laptop, and the dated version label

n2.japanese: じゃ、空欄は空欄のまま出す。勝手に補う処理はなし。版の日付も見えるようにする。古い版に戻るのは、もうなし。
n2.reading: じゃ、くうらんはくうらんのままだす。かってにおぎなうしょりはなし。はんのひづけもみえるようにする。ふるいはんにもどるのは、もうなし。
n2.english: Then blank cells stay blank on screen. No automatic filling-in. I'll make the version date visible too. No going back to the old version again.

n1.japanese: じゃ、空欄は空欄のまま出す。勝手に補う処理はなし。版の日付も見えるようにするよ。前みたいに『古いほうが見やすい』で戻るの、もう嫌だから。
n1.reading: じゃ、くうらんはくうらんのままだす。かってにおぎなうしょりはなし。はんのひづけもみえるようにするよ。まえみたいに『ふるいほうがみやすい』でもどるの、もういやだから。
n1.english: Then blank cells stay blank on screen. No helpful filling-in. I'll make the version date visible too. I don't want us going back again because 'the old one is easier to read.'

nodes.intent: Weigh the two sources against each other, conclude only to the level the record supports, and set the map's line as the way the class will one day close the atlas.
nodes.attentionTarget: the letter and the physical page side by side, and the line the map draws between what can and cannot be said

n2.japanese: うん。手紙にあるのはここまで。紙から読めるのもここまで。『最初の一人』は、どちらにもない。会場への返事は、この凡例を見てから書こう。
n2.reading: うん。てがみにあるのはここまで。かみからよめるのもここまで。『さいしょのひとり』は、どちらにもない。かいじょうへのへんじは、このはんれいをみてからかこう。
n2.english: Right. This is as far as the letter goes, and this is as far as the paper takes us. Neither has 'the first person.' Let's check this legend before replying to the venue.

n1.japanese: うん。手紙に書いてあるのはここまで。紙から読めるのもここまで。『最初の一人』には、どちらの資料も触れてない。……よし。会場から何を言われても、返事を書く前にこの凡例を見よう。
n1.reading: うん。てがみにかいてあるのはここまで。かみからよめるのもここまで。『さいしょのひとり』には、どちらのしりょうもふれてない。……よし。かいじょうからなにをいわれても、へんじをかくまえにこのはんれいをみよう。
n1.english: Right. This is as far as the letter goes. This is as far as the paper takes us. Neither source mentions 'the first person.' …Good. Whatever the venue asks, we check this legend before writing back.

nodes.description: The closing bell sounds. Under the reading lamp, every claim now carries two separate marks: a source line and a confidence shade. Henry's screen matches the paper grid exactly. As Sophie caps her darkest pen, the library printer wakes and produces the venue's final-panel request: one founder, one clean ending. She lays it face-down on the finished legend for tomorrow.

callbacks.meaningNow: The number notebook becomes a shared evidence map: colour now encodes how sure a claim is and what kind of source it came from, source attribution and hedging carry each claim at its true confidence, and one cell is a labelled blank for what the record cannot support.
callbacks.optionalFallback: Sophie and Henry simply sort the three sources into a table, colour each entry by how sure they are, and leave the earliest-origin claim as a blank marked 'we don't know this yet.'

outcomes.description: The class turns its number notebook into a provenance evidence map that marks each claim's source kind and confidence in colour, records the former learner's declined question without inventing an answer, and leaves the earliest-origin claim as a visible labelled blank rather than filling it.

The student who once wanted every cell filled and correct builds a map whose strongest mark is a blank labelled 'we don't know this yet'; her colour-coding becomes a calibration tool for confidence and source kind, and she is at peace concluding only as far as the record supports. She has become the class's calibration voice.

Having learned at his limit that provenance is an absence no author field can fix, Henry stops reaching to plug the gap and instead builds structure that shows its uncertainty: the map's data shows empty cells empty and dates its versions so no cleaner draft overwrites the truth. The class can now ask him to structure a record that says out loud where it is not certain.

Synthesis, source-quality weighing, and calibrated-certainty evidence returns only after the learner assembles all three source, confidence, and Japanese evidence-phrase rows in the chapter's transfer activity; the story emits no lesson-completion command.

replay.withdrawnContentFallback: Use the same synthesis-and-calibration beats with neutral nameplates: two classmates weigh a partial letter against physical page evidence, mark each claim's confidence and source in colour, record a declined question without inventing it, and leave the unsupported origin as a labelled blank.
